children.text: A conversation becomes a native artifact
Describe an idea here. Review it in GPUI. Ask for changes in the conversation.

For example: Generate a native artifact explaining our prototype architecture, including the reload flow and the next three milestones. I translate the request into the supported artifact primitives and validate the JSON.
Open this report in Informe. Read and copy text normally, or choose Select components to target a metric, chart, or table. Click Comment… to ask for a change.
3. Send feedback and review the revision

Choose Send feedback to agent while the agent is waiting with review --wait. The agent receives the comment and original target, applies a guarded revision, and the viewer highlights semantic changes.

children.title: Local review with your existing agent
children.body: Feedback is stored beside this file and read by the CLI. The viewer makes no model calls. The agent must be running the review adapter to receive it; buttons inside artifacts still support only noop.
